title: SIDESTORY: WHAT THE FIRELIGHT CASTS OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: WHAT THE FIRELIGHT CASTS OPEN
DURATION: July 13, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 03, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: What the Firelight Casts event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the Event Store.
EVENT STAGES DURATION: Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
- [Swamp In The Mists] Duration: July 13, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – July 27, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Ashes of Memories] Duration: July 20, 2023, 16:00 (UTC-7) – July 27, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Search Warrant from the City Council
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Search Warrant from the City Council] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Puzzle, Reed's Cabin Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Manuscripts of Ballads, etc.
River Valley Caravan
DURATION: July 13, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) - August 03, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Manuscripts of Ballads by clearing event stages. Manuscripts of Ballads can be used to redeem items from [River Valley Caravan].
MAIN REWARDS: Puzzle's Token, Reed's Cabin Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, etc.
NOTE: During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN - TO BLOOM FROM A DIM FLAME
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [To Bloom From a Dim Flame], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Reed the Flame Shadow
★★★★★: Harmonie / Skyfire
03 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game.
★★★★★★: Reed the Flame Shadow
★★★★★: Harmonie
★★★★★: Puzzle
NOTE:
- Operator Puzzle is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event What the Firelight Casts. Operator Puzzle is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
- Operator Reed the Flame Shadow, Harmonie, and Puzzle will gain more trust in the event stages.
04 ICEFIELD MESSENGER COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- Icefield Messenger Collection - Maiden for the Bright Night for Goldenglow
- Icefield Messenger Collection - Untold Stories for Erato
- Icefield Messenger Collection - Aftershow for Greyy the Lightningbearer
05 CAMBRIAN SERIES RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
- Cambrian Series - Soft Wool for Bibeak
- Cambrian Series - Casual for Arene
- Cambrian Series - Modeling Night for Gravel
06 NEW FURNITURE SET – REED’S CABIN
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Reed's Cabin, will be available during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- What the Firelight Casts event rewards and redeem in River Valley Caravan (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces) from July 13, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – July 27, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
07 NEW LUCKY DROP FURNITURE SET - DETECTIVE'S STUDY
UPDATE TIME: July 13, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7)
LUCKY DROP: Themed Furniture - Detective's Study
HOW TO OBTAIN: By clearing Main Theme stages (excludes Challenge Mode and tutorial stages) and all Supplies stages.

DETAILS: New furniture series, Detective's Study, will replace the current furniture series in the Lucky Drop, Instrument Repair Workshop. After the replacement, Instrument Repair Workshop series furniture can be purchased at the Store.
Instrument Repair Workshop will be available at the Store after July 13, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7)
08 CHIP PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DETAILS: During the event, the following pack will be available from the Store for a limited time.
Dim Flame Chip Pack
CONTENTS: Medic Chip Pack * 8, Medic Chip * 5, and LMD * 210000.
09 LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 10 days to receive generous rewards, including: Pudding's Exclusive Outfit, Orundum, Emergency Sanity Concentrate, Module Materials, and etc.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, LMD * 30000.
Day 2: Orundum * 200, Recruitment Permit * 5
Day 3: Chip Catalyst * 1, Skill Summary - 1 * 30
Day 4: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Furniture Part * 300
Day 5: Icefield Messenger Collection - Gleaming Fey for Pudding * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 6: Orundum * 200, Pure Gold * 20
Day 7: Data Supplement Instrument * 3, Skill Summary - 2 * 20
Day 8: Module Data Block * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 9: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 10: Orundum * 200, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Arknights Operation Team
